avenues.title: Procrustes/CKA-invariant MSE: the minimal ARH-motivated upgrade to OPRD-Vanilla
avenues.description: OPRD-Vanilla matches teacher coordinates via L2-normed pointwise MSE, which penalizes rotation and per-dimension scale, exactly the nuisance transforms ARH shows are NOT shared across models. Replace it with a loss that quotients out only those nuisances but keeps distances: online orthogonal-Procrustes-aligned MSE (per-batch SVD of the teacher-student cross-covariance, then MSE in aligned space), run as a ladder against raw MSE, L2-norm MSE (OPRD default), a CKA/log-CKA loss (rotation+isotropic-scale invariant), and full-linear CCA/whitened MSE (too-invariant control). This localizes where between 'match coordinates' and 'discard geometry' the training signal lives, using cheap linear algebra on activations OPRD already caches.
avenues.whyNovel: OPRD's bridge uses a frozen global PCA projector + MSE (digest 1.3); no online Procrustes/CKA-invariant variant is tried same-arch. CKA-QAD uses full-batch Gram CKA with no per-token gradient; Procrustes-MSE is per-token, cheaper, and separates orthogonal- from scale-invariance as distinct rungs.
avenues.firstExperiment: Same-arch Qwen2.5-1.5B pair (JustRL teacher, R1-distill student), 500 steps, drop-in for all-layer MSE, 3 seeds, last-2000 mask. Report Avg@16 on AIME24/25/AIMO for the 5-rung ladder. If orthogonal-Procrustes-MSE ties raw MSE within ~1pt seed noise, ARH's nuisance-invariance story is dead for training; if it beats MSE and tracks CKA, the cheap sweet spot is found.
avenues.risk: Online per-batch Procrustes SVD can be unstable at small batch; any win may sit inside AIME seed variance (OPRD deltas ~0.6pt), needing more seeds than budget allows.

avenues.title: Temperature-interpolated local relation loss: one knob spanning distance to identity
avenues.description: Rather than pre-committing to identity-only (ARH) or distance-preserving (RKD/LSP), build a single PKT-style loss over local neighbors: for each supervised token, take its top-k neighbors within the token window by teacher similarity, form a softmax-over-similarities distribution at temperature tau for teacher and student, match by KL. Sweep tau from high (soft, preserves the full local distance distribution ~ RKD/LSP) to low (peaked, approaches hard neighbor-identity ~ ARH). One parametric family answers the whole 'what point between MSE and pure identity is best' question along a single decisive axis, with representation stable-rank tracked at every tau to catch collapse.
avenues.whyNovel: PKT (2018) fixes one temperature and only ties vanilla KD; RKD/LSP keep raw distances with no locality/softness knob; ARH never tests identity as a loss. The swept-tau local-window formulation over on-policy LLM rollouts, treating distance-vs-identity as a continuum not a binary, is untested.
avenues.firstExperiment: Same 1.5B same-arch pair, last-layer + all-layer variants, sweep tau in {0.05,0.2,1.0,5.0} x k in {8,32} x 3 seeds, 500 steps. Plot Avg@16 vs tau. Monotone improvement toward low tau confirms ARH's identity prescription; a peak or improvement at high tau (distance end) refutes it and vindicates RKD/LSP. Add representation stable-rank per tau; drop any arm whose rank collapses even as loss/alignment improve.
avenues.risk: Softmax-over-similarity is InfoNCE/SNNL-family with known collapse and temperature pathologies; the optimum may be a flat plateau giving no clear distance-vs-identity verdict.

avenues.title: MiniLM-v2 self-relation transfer as a projector-free ARH-Bridge for cross-architecture
avenues.description: Replace OPRD-Bridge's frozen-PCA + learned-linear-map + MSE (the global-spectral mechanism ARH indicts) with MiniLM-v2-style within-sequence relation transfer adapted to on-policy rollouts: compute the token-token self-similarity matrix (hidden-hidden, or Q-Q/K-K/V-V) within the last-k window for student and teacher, row-normalize by softmax, and match rows by KL. This is dot-product-based, so intrinsically rotation/scale invariant and width/depth agnostic with NO projector and NO Stage-1 bridge pretraining, cheaper than OPRD-Bridge. The row-softmax keeps relative magnitudes (distance-flavored) while emphasizing top local neighbors, sitting squarely between pointwise MSE and pure identity.
avenues.whyNovel: MiniLM-v2 (2020) is same-arch encoder pretraining, offline, no reasoning eval; OPRD-Bridge (2026) needs a trained PCA projector and loses to OPD top-1 on Avg@16 (Table 4: 11.2 vs 15.3). Projector-free token-relation transfer on on-policy reasoning rollouts against that honest low bar is unclaimed.
avenues.firstExperiment: Cross-arch Qwen3-4B->Qwen3-1.7B-Base (OPRD-Bridge's exact Table 4 setup), 3 seeds. Must clear OPRD-Bridge's 11.2 Avg@16 and ideally OPD top-1's 15.3. Include RKD-distance and CKA/Gram baselines so a win isolates the relation-transfer contribution, not just 'relational beats PCA+MSE'. If it cannot beat 11.2 with seeds, the projector-free relation bridge is dead.
avenues.risk: Cross-arch 1.5-4B is a near-floor regime (student 2.8 Avg@16); 1-4pt deltas on a degenerate floor with no error bars may be uninterpretable even at 3 seeds.

avenues.title: Local-neighborhood DISTANCE-preserving bridge (LN-Dist), not identity-only
avenues.description: The plan's headline risk (verdicts C2/C10): identity-only relational losses have zero positive precedent - RKD/PKT/SP tie-or-lose vanilla KD, and the only relational winners (RKD, LSP) KEPT distances. So invert the plan: keep ARH's LOCALITY (the part surviving width/depth null-calibration) but keep distances. Loss = per-token local distance matching: for each supervised student token, take its top-k neighbors within the response window and match the teacher's pairwise-distance sub-matrix over those same k tokens (Huber on distances, L2-normalized, dimension-agnostic so no projector needed). Bridges cross-width Qwen3-4B->1.7B and cross-tokenizer with a parameter-free loss, and only has to clear OPRD-Bridge's low bar (Table 4: it loses to OPD top-1, 11.2 vs 15.3 Avg@16).
avenues.whyNovel: RKD (2019) matches distances over the GLOBAL batch; MLDR-KD (2026) matches class/sample relation matrices; OPRD-Bridge uses global PCA+coordinate-MSE, a global-spectral mechanism ARH shows is confounded. None do per-token LOCAL-window top-k distance matching on autoregressive LLM hidden states on-policy. Novelty = locality x distance-preservation, the empirically-supported quadrant the plan skipped.
avenues.firstExperiment: Pure measurement, hours on one GPU, no training: on the frozen same-arch pair (JustRL-1.5B / R1-distill-1.5B) and cross-width Qwen3-4B/1.7B pair, over 2000-token rollouts compute width/depth-null-calibrated alignment three ways: global-distance (RKD), identity-only (mutual-kNN), local-window top-k distance. If local-distance beats neither global-distance nor identity-only on the calibrated metric, kill before any training.
avenues.risk: Local distance is still geometric, so causal inertness in generation tokens (2605.23315) can null it; may merely tie a well-tuned PCA+MSE same-arch, with real signal only cross-arch.

avenues.title: Anchor-fingerprint bridge for cross-tokenizer (parameter-free, alignment-free)
avenues.description: Cross-tokenizer is OPRD-Bridge's ONLY clean win, and only because OPD structurally cannot run (degenerate baseline) - a low, honest bar. But PCA+MSE still needs a fragile per-token teacher<->student correspondence across mismatched tokenizers. Kill that need: fix a shared pool of M anchor texts (math lemmas/tokens), encode once through BOTH frozen models offline. Represent every rollout token by its cosine-similarity vector to the M anchors - an M-dim, width-agnostic, tokenizer-agnostic fingerprint (a data-defined kernel embedding, no learned projector, no PCA). Match student vs teacher fingerprint SETS over a sliding window via Sinkhorn OT (soft correspondence), so no hard token alignment is ever required. Target pair: Phi-4-mini-reasoning -> Qwen3-1.7B-Base (OPRD Table 6).
avenues.whyNovel: ULD/MultiLevelOT (2402.12030, AAAI25) do OT over LOGIT distributions (need LM head/vocab overlap); DSKD-CMA (2603.22056) learns cross-attention; OPRD-Bridge does per-token PCA+MSE needing token alignment. Anchor-fingerprint OT is parameter-free, operates on hidden-state kernel embeddings (reasoning-internal, not output), and dissolves cross-tokenizer alignment via the anchor basis - none of the three do this.
avenues.firstExperiment: Offline retrieval sanity check, no training: build fingerprints for held-out semantically-aligned Phi-4/Qwen3 sentence pairs. Test whether fingerprint cosine retrieves the known cross-model correspondence better than raw-PCA-projected states (top-1 retrieval accuracy). Sweep M and anchor choice. If fingerprints cannot recover correspondences PCA already recovers, the OT target is noise - kill before training.
avenues.risk: Anchor set may not span reasoning-relevant directions (frequency-biased per 2605.28870); OT over fingerprints may be too weak a gradient at the near-floor 1.5B cross-tokenizer regime (student 2.8 Avg@16), lost in seed noise.

avenues.title: Functional (logit-lens) bridge that hedges causal inertness
avenues.description: The sharpest threat to EVERY geometric bridge - pointwise, PCA, and relational alike - is Convergence Without Understanding (2605.23315): representational alignment is causally near-inert (1.5-5.5% flip rate) exactly in the generation-token region OPRD supervises. No bridge in the plan addresses this. Fix: bridge on FUNCTION, not coordinates. At each mapped layer, pass both models' hidden states through a shared frozen readout - the teacher's LM head restricted to a shared sub-vocabulary (cross-tokenizer: a small shared byte/digit set), or a tiny probe head - and match induced next-token distributions with forward-KL. This optimizes what the representation PREDICTS, not its geometry, hedging the one critique that nulls geometric matching. Composable with OPD. Pairs: Qwen3-4B->1.7B-Base (shared vocab) and Phi-4->Qwen3 (shared sub-vocab).
avenues.whyNovel: OPRD-Bridge matches coordinates (MSE); CKA-QAD/Beyond-Output-Matching (2606.05682) matches global Gram - both still geometric. RKD/MLDR-KD match relations. None route intermediate hidden states through a shared functional readout at bridge time specifically to escape causal inertness in generation tokens. A bridge defined by predictive equivalence, not representational similarity.
avenues.firstExperiment: Correlation probe, frozen models, no distillation: over generation tokens compute per-token geometric bridge-alignment (PCA cosine) AND functional-alignment (logit-lens KL through shared head), correlate each with downstream answer correctness and with the token's causal flip-rate. If functional-alignment tracks correctness/causality while geometric does not, the design is motivated and its win predicted; if both fail equally, the whole hidden-state-bridge premise is in doubt - a high-value negative.
avenues.risk: May collapse into ordinary intermediate-layer logit distillation with no gain over a tuned OPD top-16 baseline; shared sub-vocabulary probe can discard too much information cross-tokenizer, starving the signal.

avenues.title: LM-head spectral decomposition of the OPRD gradient: is null-space supervision causal or inert?
avenues.description: OPRD's Theorem 2 asserts W_head has a large effective null space where hidden deviations produce ~zero output loss but full MSE penalty, and this is its stated justification for beating OPD. Nobody tests whether supervising that null space actually causes accuracy gains or is wasted. SVD W_head once; split the teacher-student hidden residual at each supervised token into W_head row-space (softmax-readable) and null-space (softmax-invariant) components. Track what fraction of the OPRD MSE gradient norm lands in each over training, then causally isolate each by training row-space-only and null-space-only MSE variants. Directly tests OPRD's central mechanistic claim rather than assuming it.
avenues.whyNovel: OPRD Thm 2 only bounds null-space size, never tests if supervising it helps. 'Convergence Without Understanding' (2605.23315) shows generation-token alignment is causally near-inert but never decomposes by LM-head spectrum. No one projects the OPRD gradient onto W_head row/null bases.
avenues.firstExperiment: One-time SVD of W_head. P_row = top-r right singular dirs, P_null = complement. Run 3 OPRD variants at Qwen2.5-1.5B, 500 steps, identical rollouts: full-MSE, MSE(P_row·residual), MSE(P_null·residual). Compare AIME24/25 Avg@16, 3 seeds + CIs, plus per-step gradient-norm fraction in each subspace. Decisive: null-only ≈ student floor while row-only ≈ full-OPRD falsifies the LM-head-bottleneck story; the reverse confirms it.
avenues.risk: Row/null projection interacts with OPRD's L2-normalization; 500-step deltas may sit inside AIME seed noise without adequate seeds/CIs.

avenues.title: Does OPRD escape OPD's locked subspace, and does the escape align with the LM-head null space?
avenues.description: The geometry paper shows OPD locks a rank-16 update subspace early and rank-16-projected training leaves OPD essentially unchanged - but it only ran OPD, never OPRD, never a cross-objective projection, and never linked the locked subspace to W_head. Hypothesis: OPRD's update subspace has a component orthogonal to OPD's V_16 that aligns with W_head's bottom singular directions - i.e. OPRD gains live precisely in directions the LM head cannot read and OPD structurally cannot reach. Unifies subspace-lock and LM-head-null-space into one testable mechanistic story with a cross-objective functional-sufficiency test.
avenues.whyNovel: Geometry paper (2606.07082) runs stable-rank/V_16-lock/rank-16-projection on OPD only, no OPRD, no cross-objective projection, no W_head link. OPRD paper does zero geometry. The OPD-vs-OPRD locked-subspace overlap and its alignment to W_head's null space is entirely unmeasured.
avenues.firstExperiment: From shared init, train OPD and OPRD ~300 steps (4B for cleaner SVD, replicate 1.5B). Extract top-16 right-singular subspaces of cumulative ΔW (CPU float64 SVD, attention + MLP). Principal angles V_16^OPD vs V_16^OPRD; orthogonalize OPRD's residual subspace against OPD's and measure its energy in W_head's bottom vs top singular directions. Cross-sufficiency: constrain OPRD gradient to V_16^OPD - accuracy dropping to OPD level proves OPRD's gains live outside OPD's channel.
avenues.risk: 1.5B SVD instability (source needed 8B); the orthogonal-residual subspace may be noise-dominated, yielding a null hard to distinguish from 'no real escape.'

avenues.title: Where does teacher-student neighbor identity live: the readable subspace or the null space?
avenues.description: A pure-measurement kill-switch for the entire relational/ARH-Bridge program (plan B/E). ARH says local neighbor identity survives cross-model, motivating a neighbor-matching loss - but nobody has asked whether that neighbor signal is already recoverable from the W_head row-space (accessible to output-space OPD) or lives in the null-space that only a hidden-state loss reaches. Compute teacher-student mutual-kNN agreement per layer on rollout tokens after projecting hidden states onto full / top-r PCA / W_head row-space / W_head null-space. This pinpoints the causal niche - if any - for a hidden-state relational loss before any training compute is spent.
avenues.whyNovel: ARH (2602.14486) measures mutual-kNN only on full representations of independently-trained models; never decomposes which subspace carries it. OPRD-Bridge uses global PCA, not neighbor structure. No one asks whether the neighbor signal ARH-Bridge would match is already in output-readable directions.
avenues.firstExperiment: No training. On DAPO-Math student+teacher rollouts, compute mutual-kNN(k=10) layer-wise on hidden states projected onto: full, top-r PCA, W_head row-space, W_head null-space; sweep k and eval-set size (1K to 100K) to check ARH's eval-scale fragility. Repeat on OPD- vs OPRD-trained students. Decisive: neighbor identity fully recoverable from W_head row-space kills B/E (output-space already has it); concentration in null-space pinpoints the mechanism justifying a hidden-state relational loss.
avenues.risk: Mutual-kNN is eval-scale fragile (Back into Plato's Cave); small effect sizes and layer/k sensitivity could make results ambiguous without a proper sweep.
